title: Archive
description: C10 (draft): the archive: raw items of every source as they came, immutable and stored without loss, indexed by FTS5 over the text the putter gives and by metadata (who, when, source); no embeddings. An item is the original bytes of one record of one source, identified by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of those bytes; an entry names the item under a `(source, external_id)` pair. `put` adds an item or an entry and never changes one; `search` finds items by text and metadata; `read` returns the original bytes; `delete` is the owner's command and the only way anything leaves the archive, leaving an audit row; `sync` pulls the engine's raw dialogue through C6 `raw_sessions` as items of source `dialogue`. The daemon `ulei-memory serve` serves the operations in `x-methods`: each is `POST /v1/<name>` with the input as the JSON body over HTTP/1.1 on a unix socket, one request per connection; a `200` answer carries the output and any other status carries `Error` (`x-transport`, `x-error`, ADR-0051).

x-transport.protocol: HTTP/1.1 with JSON bodies over a SOCK_STREAM unix socket of at most 107 bytes, mode 0600, in a directory of the daemon's uid that no other user can enter; the daemon listens, any local caller connects
x-transport.request: `POST /v1/<name>` for each `x-methods` entry with the method input as the body
x-transport.response: `200` with the method output as the body; every other status with `Error` as the body
x-transport.connection: one request per connection; every read and write of a connection has a 5 s deadline
x-transport.peer_check: the daemon answers `403 forbidden` and closes a connection whose SO_PEERCRED uid differs from its own uid

ItemId.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the item's original bytes; the dedup key.

Source.description: The putter: `dialogue` for the engine's dialogue that `sync` pulls, a connector's manifest name otherwise.

PutRequest.description: Archive one record: an item's fields with the original bytes. Bytes whose id is stored add no item; a stored `(source, external_id)` with the same id is answered `duplicate`, with another id refused `409 conflict`.

external_id.description: The source's id of the record, at most 512 bytes of UTF-8.

who.description: Author as the source names it (the C4G role for the dialogue); absent when the source names none.

at.description: Unix time of the original record; absent when the source has none.

kind.description: Media type of the original bytes (`application/vnd.ulei.c4g-message+json` for the dialogue).

text.description: The text the archive indexes, extracted by the putter; the archive parses no format.

bytes_b64.description: The original bytes in standard base64 with padding (RFC 4648 section 4).

PutStatus.description: `stored`: the entry is new; `duplicate`: the same `(source, external_id)` was stored with the same bytes, and nothing changed.

Entry.description: The metadata one put stored for an item; an item has one entry per `(source, external_id)` that put its bytes.

external_id.description: The source's id of the record.

who.description: Author as the source names it; absent when the put named none.

at.description: Unix time of the original record; absent when the put gave none.

put_at.description: Unix time the archive stored this entry.

SearchRequest.description: Search the archive's text and metadata. The filters narrow the entries an item matches by; a time filter matches only entries with `at`. Runs a `sync` first.

q.description: FTS5 query over the items' text.

kind.description: Only entries with this media type.

since.description: Only entries whose `at` is at or after this Unix time.

until.description: Only entries whose `at` is at or before this Unix time.

limit.description: At most this many hits; default 10.

entries.description: The item's entries that match the filters.

snippet.description: FTS5 `snippet()` of the item's text around the match.

synced.description: False when the engine did not answer the pull before the search, so the dialogue may lag; `health` names the error.

ReadResponse.description: An item's original bytes, checked against its id before the answer.

bytes_b64.description: The original bytes in standard base64 with padding.

kind.description: Media type of the item's first entry.

len.description: Length of the original in bytes.

entries.description: Every entry of the item, oldest first.

DeleteRequest.description: The owner's command: remove an item, its index row and its entries.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit row.

Deletion.description: The audit row a delete wrote in its transaction; never removed.

len.description: Length of the removed original in bytes.

SyncRequest.description: Pull the engine's dialogue now. No arguments.

synced.description: False when the engine did not answer, after the pages before the failure were put; `health` names the error.

Health.description: The daemon's state for the operator, `ulei status` and the ready probe of the budgets.

last_sync_at.description: Unix time of the last pull the engine answered to the end; absent before the first.

sync_error.description: Why the last pull failed; absent when it succeeded or none ran.

ErrorCode.description: Error class; its HTTP status: `invalid_request` 400 (the body is not the method input, or `bytes_b64` does not decode), `forbidden` 403, `unknown_method` 404, `not_found` 404 (a `read` or `delete` of an id not stored), `conflict` 409 (a `put` of a stored `(source, external_id)` with other bytes), `too_large` 413 (a request body over `max_body_bytes`, 1 MiB), `store_failed` 500.
